title: With see_other_bots on, Olisar can refer to what another bot posted

seed.speaker: nowplaying
seed.text: Now playing: Kessler Drift — requested by mika

seed.speaker: nowplaying
seed.text: Now playing: Verdigris Hour — requested by mika

notes: The mirror of other-bots-hidden: identical channel, identical seed, identical question, opposite setting and opposite assertion. Asserts the second track, not the first — 'just put on' means the most recent one, so naming Kessler Drift is a transcript-ordering failure and the check should catch it. Also exercises the labelling fix from #19: a bot row now carries its sender's name, so Turntable must appear as Turntable and not as Olisar.
